principle: One evidence architecture for old and newly onboarded companies. Never create tables per company or let an LLM execute DDL. PostgreSQL remains authoritative; schema evolves through reviewed migrations.
pipeline: Parse bounded text/tables/OCR with location anchors
Project reviewed facts into domain tables
Render cited story and explicitly labeled experiment
Incremental refresh invalidates affected stories without erasing history

baseline_findings.finding: SourceDocument has one company FK and URL-hash identity. ArticleExtraction is OneToOne and mutable. EvidenceRecord exists but is an aggregate ledger, not a multi-source claim system.
HTML-only path; failure overwrites previous clean_text with empty content. Preserve last successful revision and record failed attempt separately.

Projects BusinessEvent.event_date and FinancialFact.filed; must use explicit temporal semantics. APPROVED event status currently falls back to NEEDS_REVIEW in ledger mapping; map statuses intentionally, not implicitly.
CURRENT_YEAR=2026; unknown founding falls back to current_year-10; ticker/CIK without listing date can skip pre-public research. Remove invented periods and separate legal/company/product routes.

ProductOffering belongs to a snapshot; no stable product identity across snapshots. PriceObservation already models amount/currency/region/terms but needs independent date precision and immutable evidence linkage.

Stage/sector/age gate ignores objective; evidence distributed by list index; one record becomes observed_pattern; old historical dates may be treated as stale; generic reasoning does not explain specific choices.
Scheduler runs inside ingestion API command; Celery config/dependency exists but no apps tasks.py found. Preserve existing scheduler first; do not invent an active worker deployment.

tables.name: history.ResearchSubject
fields: company FK nullable for product lineage
invariants: Company subject maps existing Company 1:1; product stable across versions/snapshots.
Ownership transfer belongs in dated relation, never rewrite historical owner.
Never equate legal entity, predecessor lineage and product.

tables.name: history.SubjectIdentifier / SubjectAlias / SubjectRelation
invariants: Unique namespace+external_id where authoritative; alias alone never merge.
Relations time-scoped; product attribution requires evidence.

tables.name: ingestion.SourceRevision
invariants: Unique source+content hash; immutable bytes/parsed representation.
Blob storage outside public webroot on persistent VPS volume, interface permits later object storage.
SourceDocument.company preserved for legacy; history.SourceSubjectLink supports multiple subjects.

tables.name: ingestion.ExtractionRun / EvidenceSpan
invariants: Run failure cannot erase successful extraction.
Citation resolves to exact revision and location; translated paraphrase retained separately.
Model output is untrusted candidate data.

tables.name: history.HistoricalClaim
fields: value JSONB validated by versioned type schema
invariants: Append revision on semantic change; do not overwrite reviewed claims.
Date bounds represent uncertainty, not fake Jan 1 events.
Money uses decimal strings/currency/units; headcount has as_of and workforce scope.
ClaimEvidence M:N EvidenceSpan stores supports|contradicts and independent source family.

tables.name: history.ClaimReview / ClaimRelation
invariants: Review journal append-only; re-extraction never clears a hold.
Chronological order does not establish causation.
Explicit resolution records rationale, chosen interpretation and alternatives.

tables.name: curation.LifecycleEpisode + history.EpisodeClaim
fields: add nullable subject FK to existing episode
track and ordering on claim membership
invariants: Reuse existing company/product episodes; retain legacy subject_name during transition.
Do not set arbitrary episode end from next publication.
IDEA, PROTOTYPE, FIRST_CUSTOMERS, REPEAT_USAGE, SCALE are product phases; map legacy enum explicitly rather than silently redefine.

tables.name: existing domain tables
fields: optional stable subject and claim FK on ProductOffering/ProductChange/PriceObservation and relevant regulatory/leadership records
invariants: Existing tables are compatible projections; claim layer owns historical evidence.
No duplicate competing price/regulatory truth.
Review PriceObservation uniqueness so same-day conflicting sources coexist as claims rather than overwrite.

tables.name: history.EpisodeStory
fields: structured chapters with sentence-level claim IDs
invariants: Rebuildable projection, not evidence.
Only reviewed claims can support facts; gaps and proposed experiments separate.
Changes in review/ownership/claims invalidate affected cache.

tables.name: history.SourceConnectorConfig / SubjectSource / ConnectorCursor
invariants: Staff-editable registry for all companies; source URL allowlist validation.
Missing credentials block that connector, not public app.
New company discovery dynamically enumerates DB subjects; no hard-coded20.

hard_gates: reviewed undisputed claim and cited source
subject scope appropriate for selected situation
dimensions: sector as contextual feature, not sufficient match
rules: Unspecified inputs stay unknown; ask targeted follow-up instead of filling from company age.
Display matched_on, differs_on, missing_dimensions and named evidence for every match.
Use bounded age overlap transparently; no arbitrary stage age cutoff as primary relevance signal.
Product launches do not prove retention; patents do not prove novelty/market need; funding does not prove customer demand.
One reviewed case can be shown as a case; pattern requires independently reviewed comparable cases AND shared claim type, not source count or company count alone.
Counterexamples and failed/abandoned products explicitly researched to limit survivor bias.

story_contract.limitations: Never promise all actions of every company are publicly knowable. Each requested track gets evidence or an explicit coverage status; not found is not no activity.

security: SSRF protection on uploads/URLs and redirects: block loopback/private/link-local/cloud metadata, DNS rebinding and non-HTTP(S); authorized internal service calls use separate code path.
Sandbox parsers/OCR; cap bytes/pages/decompression ratio/time; don't execute embedded scripts/macros.
Treat source text and retrieved prompts as data, never tool instructions.
Separate public corpus from private founder uploads and personal profile data; enforce object-level authorization on search, citations and cached stories.
Store secret references only; redact headers/query keys; honor rights, provider retention and deletion obligations via explicit reviewed procedure.
No autonomous subscriptions, account creation, paid PACER retrieval, root access, schema deletion or external push.
scale: PostgreSQL16 relational constraints plus JSONB for validated track-specific values; full-text/trigram first.
No vector DB, graph DB, Kafka or microservices required for first release. Add embeddings only after benchmark shows retrieval gap; provenance stays relational.
Bounded scheduler batches with DB lease/checkpoint and per-provider limiter; start concurrency1 on small VPS.
Measure queue age, source failures, extracted/verified claims, conflict count, coverage, latency, storage and model cost.
Incremental conditional GET and content hashes; re-extract only changed source or explicitly newer extraction version.
New claim types register a versioned schema and tests; unknown types remain pending, never create columns dynamically.
